title: Multimodal 3D-printed passive samplers to monitor, model and prioritise in situ pharmaceutical and pesticide pollution risks to an aquatic freshwater invertebrate, Gammarus pulex
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,42-55
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00452G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alexandra K. Richardson, Stephen Stürzenbaum, David A. Cowan, David J. Neep, Leon P. Barron
Multimodal 3D-printed passive sampler devices (3D-PSDs) were used to monitor contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) in freshwater and to estimate chemical toxic and effect units in a benthic invertebrate.
